scoring_justification: T0: The headline quantities are final values from a long atomistic simulation; the checker cannot re-run the simulation, so it compares the agent's reported numbers to the paper's published values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold for the five scored quantities: three transition strains (%), first transition stress (GPa), and final stair-rod Burgers vector.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's published conclusion (Section 3, Fig.6 and text): transition strains ~2.3%, 4.8%, 6.0%; first transition stress ~5.6 GPa; final stair rod 1/3 a[1-00].
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct copy from paper text and reference solution solve.sh which encodes the same paper values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the actual paper-reported numbers traced to the specific conclusion statements and figures; the reference solution uses exactly those numbers, confirming consistency.

outputs.description: The three transition strain thresholds (in %), the tensile stress at the first transition (in GPa), and the Burgers vector of the stair-rod dislocation after the third transition (in Thompson tetrahedron notation or equivalent).

output_contract.notes: The scored artifact contains the headline quantities from the atomistic simulation under increasing uniaxial strain. The checker compares the reported values to the paper's reported values with appropriate tolerances; exact string match is required for the Burgers vector.
